title: The Instructions for the Fern
youtube_title: The Instructions for the Fern | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet attention can be warmer than advice.
summary: At a porch while rain ticks and nobody is late, Nana Ruth begins to tell Anil about instructions for a fern that did not like being moved. Anil wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
